Your files, your privacy

Understand what stays on your device and which connections the app makes.

Selected documents are processed in your browser. The application has no document-upload endpoint. This is a description of the implementation, not an independently certified security guarantee.

Network requests

The site host serves the app and authenticates private access. PDF, conversion, ZIP, QR, spreadsheet and OCR JavaScript libraries are bundled with the site during build and served locally from this host. OCR may download English language models from the Tesseract model host. The browser Translator and Summarizer APIs may download or use browser-managed language models. These providers may receive normal request information such as IP addresses. Local processing does not mean zero network traffic.

Advertising and usage measurement

The current application does not load third-party advertising scripts or remote analytics. There are no active AdSense placements. Optional task metrics stay on your device; search-provider reports do not establish how many PDF tasks visitors complete. Any future advertising would require an updated disclosure and the applicable choices before it is enabled.

Device storage

Favorites, recent tool identifiers and one workflow recipe are stored locally. Documents are held in memory during processing; downloads remain on your device. Clear browser site data to remove preferences. The app no longer caches authenticated pages for offline access.

Optional metrics

Metrics are off by default. When enabled, tool identifiers, processing outcomes and durations are saved on this device, up to 1,000 records. No filenames, document contents, hashes, raw error messages or user identifiers are recorded. Nothing is sent to us. Export or clear the report using the app controls. This is not a remote analytics dashboard.

Operator

iHatePDF operates from India. Support: mehbulislam81@gmail.com. If you email us, your email provider and the operator receive your email address and message. Please do not send documents, filenames, passwords or private screenshots. Support correspondence is separate from on-device document processing; this remains a private beta.

Notice scope and contact

The operator name, country and support contact above identify this beta. Questions about support correspondence can be sent to that email without attaching documents. This notice describes the current implementation; it does not establish an independent security certification or a finalized public-business privacy policy. Provider and retention details and jurisdiction-appropriate review must be completed before introducing services that collect additional visitor information.
